children: NEW YORK, Sept 24 (Reuters) - The amount of U.S. commercial paper grew in the week ended Sept 23 Federal Reserve data showed on Thursday.    U.S. seasonally adjusted commercial paper outstanding rose $19.8 billion to $1.462 trillion in the latest week.    Non-seasonally adjusted commercial paper outstanding - which some analysts consider a more reliable reading than the seasonally adjusted one since it has been distorted by the financial crisis - rose $19.6 billion to $1.463 trillion.    U.S. non-seasonally adjusted foreign financial commercial paper outstanding rose $9.2 billion to $358.6 billion.
